document.about: PMC3280740, Sensors 2009, spaceborne bistatic SAR stereo radargrammetry. Its figures set their captions above them (`Figure 11. Height uncertainty …` over its plot). The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-26: figure captions went to the wrong figure, or to none: a caption under a plot wider than the plot, or one over its figure taken by the figure above.

checks.issue: #390: the caption over its plot was a paragraph of the page.

element.text: Figure 11. Height uncertainty as a function of target latitude due to vector parallax difference uncertainty in the hybrid method for four bistatic off-nadir angles (1/10 of an image pixel assumed as co-registration uncertainty).

Figure 12. Performance comparison between the analyzed methods for spaceborne bistatic SAR stereo radargrammetry considering 1/10 of an image pixel as co-registration uncertainty and four bistatic off-nadir angles: (a) projection of bistatic parameters, (b) bistatic rigorous stereo SAR problem, (c) hybrid method.
